path.title: 突破压力,脆塑性 — 盖层需要评估其突破压力和脆塑性，以确保封存安全。
微地震,活化 — 断层可以被激活，长期注入可能导致微地震或沿断层泄漏。
压力积聚,破裂 — 如果注入压力超过盖层突破压力，可能导致盖层破裂，储层压力快速积聚。
穿孔,腐蚀 — 盖层中的腐蚀可以导致管道穿孔或断裂，对井筒完整性构成威胁。
实时监测 — 光纤传感技术(DAS/DTS)用于储层的实时温度与声波监测
强度衰退,渗透率增加,碳酸化 — 注入超临界CO2会与固井水泥发生反应，导致水泥石碳酸化、强度衰退和渗透率增加。
耐腐蚀 — 使用耐腐蚀合金油管可以缓解CO2腐蚀带来的问题。
carbonation,reaction — CO2 reacts with the cement in the well, causing carbonation which weakens the cement and increases permeability.
corrosion resistance — NACE CRA oil pipes are used to enhance the durability of the well structure in CO2 environments.
migration,monitoring — 4D Seismic technology is used to monitor the movement of CO2 underground, tracking its migration through geological formations.
near-wellbore,saturated zone — Geophysical logging techniques are used to monitor CO2 saturation levels in the near-wellbore region.
leakage,monitoring — Microseismic monitoring is used to detect small seismic events, such as fault activation and caprock fractures, to assess the integrity of the wellbore.
detection,surface — Soil gas flux measurements are used to detect abnormal CO2 concentrations and potential leaks at the surface.
contamination,surface water — Groundwater quality monitoring is used to prevent CO2 leakage from contaminating surface water resources.
detection,surface deformation — InSAR technology is used to monitor surface deformation, which can indicate potential CO2 leakage.
real-time monitoring,reservoir,wellbore — Fiber-optic sensing techniques are used for real-time temperature and acoustic monitoring of wellbore and reservoir conditions.
监测,防止 — 地下水水质监测的目的是防止CO2泄漏污染浅层水资源
监测 — 使用卫星InSAR技术来监测地表形变
实时监测 — 光纤传感技术(DAS/DTS)用于井筒的实时温度与声波监测
启动 — 如果监测到CO2泄漏，立即启动应急预案
降低 — 在监测到CO2泄漏时，立即降低注入速率
实施 — 在监测到CO2泄漏时，立即实施水力压裂
实施 — 在监测到CO2泄漏时，立即实施化学封堵

circle.title: CCUS地质封存机理 [concept] — The core mechanisms of carbon capture, utilization, and storage geological sequestration, including structural entrapment, residual gas entrapment, dissolution entrapment, and mineralization entrapment.
盖层 [naturalobject] — The cap rock, typically mudstone or gypsum layers, which must be assessed for its breakthrough pressure and brittleness.

断层 [naturalobject] — Foliation or fault lines, which can be activated by long-term injection, leading to increased pore pressure, reduced effective normal stress on fault planes, and the induction of microseismic events or leakage along fault lines.
储层 [naturalobject] — The reservoir, which requires attention to porosity, permeability, reservoir depth, temperature, and formation water salinity.
井筒完整性 [concept] — The integrity of the wellbore, which faces severe challenges in CCUS projects, particularly with respect to corrosion and structural integrity.

固井水泥 [artifact] — Cement used for cementing, which can react with supercritical CO2, leading to cement stone carbonation, strength reduction, and increased permeability, forming micro annular leakage channels.<SEP>A specific type of cement used in the process of cementing casing in oil and gas wells, which is prone to reactions with CO2.

耐腐蚀合金(CRA)油管 [artifact] — Corrosion-resistant alloy tubing, a solution to mitigate CO2 corrosion in CCUS projects.<SEP>Oil pipes made of corrosion-resistant alloys to improve the durability of the well structure in CO2 environments.
CO2 [concept] — A concept referring to carbon dioxide, a greenhouse gas that can cause various issues in well cementing and CO2 storage projects.
时移地震(4D Seismic) [method] — A seismic imaging technique used to monitor the movement of CO2 underground, tracking its migration through geological formations.
井中地球物理测井 [method] — Geophysical logging techniques performed in the wellbore to monitor CO2 saturation levels in the near-wellbore region.
微地震监测 [method] — A technique for detecting small seismic events, such as fault activation and caprock fractures, to assess the integrity of the wellbore.
土壤气体通量测量 [method] — A technique for measuring the flux of gases from the soil surface, used to detect abnormal CO2 concentrations and potential leaks.
地下水水质监测 [method] — 监测地下水水质以防止CO2泄漏污染浅层水资源<SEP>Monitoring the quality of groundwater to prevent CO2 leakage from contaminating surface water resources.
卫星InSAR技术 [method] — 使用卫星InSAR技术监测地表形变<SEP>InSAR (Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar) technology used to monitor surface deformation, which can indicate potential CO2 leakage.
光纤传感技术(DAS/DTS) [method] — A fiber-optic sensing technique for real-time temperature and acoustic monitoring of wellbore and reservoir conditions.
光纤传感技术 [method] — 使用光纤传感技术(DAS/DTS)进行井筒和储层的实时温度与声波监测
CO2泄漏 [event] — 监测到CO2泄漏事件，需要启动应急预案
应急预案 [concept] — 针对CO2泄漏事件的应急响应计划
地表形变 [UNKNOWN] — 使用卫星InSAR技术来监测地表形变
井筒 [UNKNOWN] — 光纤传感技术(DAS/DTS)用于井筒的实时温度与声波监测
注入速率 [UNKNOWN] — 在监测到CO2泄漏时，立即降低注入速率
水力压裂 [UNKNOWN] — 在监测到CO2泄漏时，立即实施水力压裂
化学封堵 [UNKNOWN] — 在监测到CO2泄漏时，立即实施化学封堵
